text:
Aisha: Quick sync on BYOK onboarding + evidence export SLA. Need crisp MVP acceptance criteria so sales/legal can stop promising vague timelines.
Marco: Proposal for MVP MUST-haves: KMS URI + metadata ingestion, signed handshake (customer sig verified), immutable audit events for handshake/key-use, and an exportable evidence bundle v1. Nice-to-have: built-in escrow workflow and Console export UI.
Priya: Add SOC2/ISO hooks as MUSTs: signed rotation events, chain-of-custody manifest format, and proof-of-possession samples. Legal wants sample wording for escrow before we market it.
Sam: Ops needs: a signed CLI to trigger evidence export, an ops runbook for failed handshakes, and CI acceptance tests that simulate rotate/handshake/export flows. Also: an emergency revoke path and a way to surface it in incidents.
Eve: Customer ask: evidence bundle must be machine-parseable (JSONL manifest + gzipped logs) and delivery SLA spelled out. Enterprises expect 48h for standard tenants and an expedited 24h for paid SLAs. For very large volumes we should support direct S3 transfer.
Aisha: Draft acceptance criteria below. Please react with :thumbsup: or suggest edits.
Aisha: MVP Acceptance Criteria (MUST):
- API: POST /v1/byok/handshakes accepts payload with customer_id, key_uri, timestamp, and signature.
- Validation: server verifies ECDSA signature against registered customer pubkey.
- Audit: emit immutable audit event per handshake and per key-operation (format: event_name, request_id, actor, outcome).
- Evidence bundle v1: on request produce signed package (manifest.json + logs slice + signed assertions) within 72h.
- Retention controls: per-tenant retention config via API (min 0d, default 90d).
- Legal hold: API flag that prevents deletions and is reflected in export manifest.
Aisha: Post-MVP (v2 / Nice-to-have):
- Automated KMS escrow orchestration + attestation report.
- Console: per-tenant retention and export history UI + download links.
- SLA tiers: 24h expedited, 48h premium, 72h standard.
Marco: Implementation notes: keep audit payloads minimal. Use existing trace_id and correlate with request_id. Suggest schema: `audit.event("byok.handshake", {request_id, customer_id, key_uri, status})`.
Priya: SOC2 evidence requirements: exported package must include chain-of-custody manifest, signed handshake payload, signed rotation events (no secret key material), and raw audit log slice. We'll provide a sample package for legal review.
Sam: Ops checklist (MVP): validate handshake failures, recreate evidence packages, emergency revoke coordinates, and test restore under legal hold. Add these as automated scenarios in CI.
Eve: On SLA for large tenants (>500GB): fallback is to provide S3 bucket with manifest + pre-signed URLs. Streaming exports are interesting but can be V2. Also: include sampling metadata if we do partial exports.
Aisha: Example request body we should include in spec: 
```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust-789",
  "key_uri": "kms://redwood/customer/us-east1/key-01",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T16:20:00Z",
  "signature": "MEUCIQDx..."
}
```
Aisha: Open questions to resolve: 1) Default retention 90d vs 180d? 2) Evidence SLA for very large tenants and whether S3 deliverable counts as "export within SLA". 3) Who owns legal-hold copy and customer-facing docs?
Priya: Legal-hold copy -> Legal + Product. I'll draft wording and circulate. For retention default recommend 90d, allow contract overrides to 180d+.
Marco: Tech note: for huge volumes we should support sampled exports and include sampling rationale in manifest. Sampling should be opt-in and clearly signaled.
Sam: I'll create an ops PR with a runbook checklist and CI scenarios by next Tue.
LegalBot: Legal looped in: assigned to @Priya for wording and escrow language review.
Eve: I'll validate bundle format with our compliance team and return feedback next week.
Aisha: Thanks team. Next actions: Marco to stub API + minimal Console wireframe; Priya to send SOC2 evidence fieldset; Sam to draft ops runbook; I'll compile RFC after these land. cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: RFC created: /rfc/evidence-bundle-and-byok-onboarding-draft (please review)
Aisha: Reconvene after RFC comments. :rocket:
